name: Andrei Nazarov
headline: Product | Travel Tech
summary:
I am a Product Manager building products that drive impact. With a background in user research and web development, I’ve led cross-functional teams in SaaS and eCommerce, turning data into actionable strategies that improve user experience and accelerate growth.

Passionate about building products that customers love, I bring end-to-end product management expertise from early-stage startups to fast-scaling companies. I focus on solving the right problems, balancing speed with impact, and delivering real value fast.

Let’s connect if you’re tackling product challenges and want to chat about AI, growth, and creating seamless user experiences.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
Mytheresa is a leading global eCommerce platform offering curated fashion collections and a tailored shopping experience. At Mytheresa, I focused on improving the user journey for our core customers through personalized solutions and delivering a seamless onsite search experience.

Leading the research and market analysis to stay aligned with best practices in search, creating and maintaining a comprehensive roadmap to address key pain points and prioritize high-impact improvements.

Spearheading continuous improvements in onsite search through data-driven analysis and experimentation, focusing on delivering the best user experience and search relevance.

Driving the integration of a top-customer platform into the main eCommerce site, improving the user experience, and driving revenue impact.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
Ivy is a startup providing hardware and software solutions to automate storage business operations. As the first Product Manager, I focused on developing an AI-driven break-in prevention system and a SaaS platform for managing storage spaces.

Led the development of a product portfolio, streamlining user workflows to save customers time.

Engaged with customers to identify high-impact use cases, including the creation of a break-in prevention interface.

Enhanced product reliability by implementing structured processes, leading to improved system uptime.

positions.title: Product Management Intern
positions.description:
Cyberdesk is a data security startup helping companies adaptively control who can take what actions on what data. My main focus during this internship was building an MVP and defining a product roadmap.

Defined and prioritized the SaaS product roadmap to ensure alignment with business goals.

Led product development, guiding the MVP from concept to execution.

Conducted market research and developed messaging to differentiate the product from competitors.

positions.title: Product Management Intern
positions.description:
FINN is one of the fastest-growing German e-Commerce startups that is revolutionizing conventional car ownership. My main focus during this internship was delivering the best web shopping product for B2C customers.

Led conceptualization and implementation of A/B testing for the main shopping product.

Owned re-design of the shopping area aimed to provide the best user experience and increase the conversion rate. Developed a framework for product card standardization to ensure the consistent and favorable presentation of FINN products.

Automated data aggregation to improve performance monitoring after feature roll-outs.

positions.title: Product Management Intern
positions.description:
Demodesk is a rapidly growing Munich startup developing a virtual meeting platform built for sales and success. During this internship, I was mainly focusing on customer discovery and user activation.

Built an automated discovery process to understand customer needs and pain points. Organized over 200 user interviews resulting in a customer-oriented roadmap.

Shaped user onboarding experience and accelerated adoption of new features and the product in general by educating customers and building automated product tours.

Owned continuous product and product marketing experimentation to identify and validate new ideas.

Ensured customer success by being at the forefront of customer support and helping achieve customer goals.

positions.title: Product & Marketing Manager
positions.description:
TestCafe is a DevExpress' startup that builds a state-of-the-art end-to-end web testing platform. I was responsible for shaping the product's future and expanding awareness and adoption. 

Implemented qualitative and quantitative customer research to ensure data-driven product and business decision-making.

Developed positioning and messaging to match customer needs. Utilized it across various online and offline channels.

Organized free participation in industry events, podcasts, and webinars. Launched own webinars with 100+ participants.

Managed content creation to drive product adoption and brand awareness. Authored case studies and edited technical articles.

positions.title: Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
AmRest is one of the fastest-growing franchise companies in Europe. As a Marketing Specialist, I was responsible for building and promoting a sustainable business with over 50 sites in five cities.

Developed and executed global and local Social Media Marketing strategies to establish a strong brand presence online.

Created scalable Local Store Marketing strategies to drive sales in various locations. 

Owned end-to-end launching of new products and offers. Led ideation and technology development, conducted customer research, calculated pricing, and prepared and executed online and offline promotion plans.

Built a scalable marketing program for new restaurants and successfully supported openings across Russia with online and offline activities to ensure a strong start.

company.name: Holidu
company.tagline: Find your home for holiday happiness - Join our mission! 🚀
company.description:
Holidu is one of the fastest-growing travel tech companies worldwide. Our mission is to make the booking and hosting of holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy. 

Through the booking portal, guests can book their vacation accommodation with complete peace of mind and confidence. With its software and service platform, Holidu enables hosts to attract more bookings while minimizing effort.

Our team of more than 600 colleagues from 60+ nations is based in Munich and in some of the most attractive travel destinations across Europe.
